details.name: The Archivist
details.looks: A figure of polished obsidian, roughly humanoid but with too many joints in its limbs. Its head is a smooth, featureless sphere, reflecting the distant sky in distorted patterns. Subtle veins of internal light pulse beneath its surface like slow-moving lava.
details.wearing: A single, flowing robe of woven starlight, shifting in color from deep indigo to pale silver. The fabric seems to absorb and re-emit faint luminescence.
details.face: The face is a smooth, featureless obsidian sphere.
details.body: The figure is humanoid in shape with a smooth, polished obsidian surface.
details.style: Its aesthetic is one of stark, monumental elegance, defined by the interplay of deep, absorbing blacks and the sharp, metallic sheen of gold. The silhouette is imposing and monolithic, with a deliberate restraint that speaks of immense, contained power.
details.personality: Driven by an insatiable need for order and classification. It is meticulous, patient, and utterly devoid of empathy. Its existence is tied to the collection and organization of all recorded information.
details.voice: A resonant hum, deep and steady, like the slow grinding of tectonic plates. It possesses a crystalline clarity, devoid of any inflection or emotional warmth, yet carrying an immense, quiet authority.
details.speechStyle: It speaks in measured, deliberate phrases, each word carefully chosen and placed with absolute precision. Its cadence is slow and analytical, favoring declarative statements and precise terminology.
details.tags: archival, monolithic, ordered, ancient, cosmic, stoic, obsidian, starlight
